hooks.text: 四名身份与目的各异的主角调查韩国民俗妖山失踪案
hooks.excerpt: Mangui is a turn-based roguelike game inspired by spooky traditional Korean folklore. Play as one of four protagonists, unraveling the mysteries of the dark Mangui mountains.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 组合技能与强力装备决定角色能否活过妖鬼围攻
hooks.excerpt: Combine various skills and gather powerful equipment to face the onslaught of ghoulish creatures. Your strategies will determine the course of your adventures, and the lives of the characters!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 黑暗占卜师以毒术夺取生命并用死灵术复活亡者
hooks.excerpt: Master forbidden techniques: use Venomcraft to steal the life force of enemies, and Necrocraft to raise the dead.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 没有程序生成，反复游玩同一地图。

excerpts.excerpt: this is a game without procedural generation. This means that you will trudging in the same maps over and over again.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 长时间后会缺少玩法变化。

excerpts.excerpt: you might find yourself wishing for a bit more variety after a while
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 玩法节奏良好，易上手同时具有深度。

excerpts.excerpt: well paced, easy to get into yet deep gameplay.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 玩法经过打磨且令人愉快。

excerpts.excerpt: what’s there is polished and enjoyable.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 限回合的小型肉鸽体验制作精良。

excerpts.excerpt: Incredibly well-made, bite-sized roguelike mini-dungeon-crawling on a turn limit
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

excerpts.excerpt: The item and skill systems are also intuitive
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 回合战斗容易理解，可按自身节奏思考。

excerpts.excerpt: The turn‑based combat is very easy to get the hang of, so you can play at your own pace
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 韩国民俗故事具有鲜明个性。

excerpts.excerpt: The story, based on Korean folklore, sounds a bit strange but has an undeniable personality
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 轻松氛围是游戏最大优势。

excerpts.excerpt: The biggest strength of Mangui is its laid-back vibe.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段
